item.title: Hegi Soba: Seaweed-Bound Buckwheat Noodles, Elegantly Plated — Guide
item.description: Hegi soba is a distinctive Niigata noodle tradition, its buckwheat noodles bound with funori, a type of edible seaweed, rather than the egg typically used elsewhere in Japan, giving the noodles a notably smooth, glossy texture and slight chewiness. The dish takes its name from the wooden hegi tray it’s traditionally served on, with the noodles arranged in elegant, bite-sized folds (tsumami) rather than a simple pile, making it both a distinctive regional specialty and a visually memorable dining experience.
